listing.name: Resource Stack Size Mod Bundle
listing.summary: Changes the maximum stack size of resources like Supplies, Fuel, Crew, and Marines.
listing.aiSummary: Changes the maximum stack size of resources like Supplies, Fuel, Crew, and Marines.
listing.partOfThreadTitle: MOD -  The TINY MOD collection. Mods without graphics. (178+ mods)

description: These mods allow you to swap stack sizes whenever you like. If you swap and load a saved game, the previous stack size might still apply, but pushing the sort button solves that.
